process.0.long: Bipo long mipela i wokim wanpela samting, mipela i laik save long bisnis bilong yu: wanem em laik bilong yu, husat i lukim websait, na wanem ol wok i gat bikpela mining. Bihain mipela i makim wanem i go pastaim bai wok i stap long stret rot na i no lus moni.

process.1.long: Mipela i putim stret ol pes na wanpela piksa bilong luk pastaim. Yu ken skelim na givim tok bipo long mipela i statim wok, bai pinis wok i stap klostu long wanem yu bin tingim.

process.2.long: Taim disain i orait pinis, mipela i wokim websait, app, o otomesen. I fit long fon na kompiuta, na yu ken givim tok taim wok i go yet.

faq.title: Ol askim i save kamap bipo long yumi statim wok.
faq.description: Sapos askim bilong yu i no gat bekim hia, wanpela toktok i ken helpim long painim ol laik bilong yu.
faq.0.question: Wanem ol wok Nocoding i ken mekim?
faq.0.answer: Mipela i wokim portfolio websait o CV bilong yu yet, landing page o profael bilong kampani, ol sistem bilong save na wok, na otomesen bilong ol wok bilong bisnis.
faq.1.question: Wok i kisim hamas taim?
faq.1.answer: Wanpela portfolio, CV, o isi landing page i save kisim 1-3 de bilong wok bihain long ol samting i redi. Ol bikpela projek i bihainim ol wok yu laikim, ol bungim, na hamas taim yu givim tok.
faq.2.question: Yumi ken senisim disain na ol wok?
faq.2.answer: Yes. Disain, ol pes, ol wok, na wok flo i ken senis long ol laik bilong yu. Yumi skelim disain wantaim bipo wok i statim.
faq.3.question: Wanem samting i stap insait long prais?
faq.3.answer: Prais i karim wok bilong wokim bihainim pekij na hamas wok yumi orait long en. Liklik pekij i gat lukautim fri na domen bilong 1 yia, na Bikpela pekij i gat lukautim fri na hosting bilong 1 yia.
contact.title: Tokim mipela long ol laik bilong websait bilong yu. Mipela bai helpim yu stretim rot.
contact.description: Salim sotpela tok long bisnis bilong yu, ol pes yu laikim, na taim yu laikim. Namba wan bekim bai gat tok bilong wanem wok na ol next step. Toktok i fri oltaim, long wanem taim yu laikim.

project.description.nebulist: Wanpela helpim bilong salim i gat AI i wokim strategi, nots bilong ol man yu laik salim, na ol draft bilong ol tok, long save bilong prodak.

project.description.payguppy: Wanpela app i helpim ol stua i no bikpela long kisim pe long dijitel moni long yusim ol QR kod ol i gat pinis.

project.description.tiptap: Wanpela ples bilong ol kriet bilong kontens bilong kisim tip long ol man i lukim long dijitel moni o ol dijitel kolekt, wantaim ol notis long taim bilong laiv.
project.description.senkus: Wanpela gem long intanet bilong saiens na alkemi: ol pleia i bungim ol poson, kisim ol dijitel samting, na pait long wanpela arena.
project.description.quickstock: Wanpela kompiuta app bilong lukautim stok bilong wanpela stua bilong klos: raitim ol salim, ol samting i kam long ol saplaia, na ol ripot bilong stok, wantaim raits bilong kam insait bihainim wok bilong olgeta wokman.
